author_decisions.decision: Stage A execution cap 6.5 L40S GPU-h (was 5.5). The A0 projection gate in code stays at 5.5 and is unchanged.
author_decisions.reason: The implemented GPU jobs also carry CPU work that the 126 s/item calibration does not include (A-1b reads the 100k and 300k dev_train marginals inside the job; A-3 fits and the A-2 bootstrap run in-job). With 4.90 h projected against 5.5, A-3 (last in the order) would be the item most likely lost. Ledger check: 122.4807 + 6.5 + 3.5 = 132.48 <= 160.

author_decisions.decision: No guard bypass in this extension. Every GPU job goes through scripts/jepa_run.sh. A guard HOLD means wait and retry (about every 15 min); it is not a STOP. Send the author a one-line status note every 24 h of continuous HOLD.
author_decisions.reason: The 3 Nov view-design evaluations bypassed the guard; a bypass also skips the per-process memory cap that only the launcher sets. The other user's jobs on deepthought2 take priority.

author_decisions.decision: If Deepthought is unreachable or drops SSH sessions, the CPU-only steps (inventory, report, standalone checks) run on deepthought2 CPU with nice -n 10 and OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS threads = 4. Never a Deepthought GPU. One DECISIONS line.
author_decisions.reason: Deepthought dropped every SSH session after 5-7 min from 3 Nov 11:37 CET; the Phase-1 work already used this fallback. The scripts/jepa_cpu_launch.py front door is restricted to the predictability modules and to deepthought, so CPU steps run directly.

author_decisions.decision: Run A-1 and A-2 once each, with --include-t1, after the four T-1 runs are complete. Until then the Stage A job slot runs A-1b -> A-4 -> A-3 (their relative order unchanged). If T-1 cannot complete (an A1 s = 0.30 row fails, or a T-1 run fails after one fix attempt), run A-1 and A-2 without --include-t1 as soon as the slot is free. The wall time of an --include-t1 job is split between the Stage A and T-1 caps in proportion to item-equivalents (A-1: 39 base / 4 T-1; A-2: 8 base / 8 T-1). No reading, threshold or item changes.
author_decisions.reason: As implemented, readout --include-t1 recomputes the whole base list plus the T-1 labels (readout_label_list), so running A-1/A-2 in Stage A and again for T-1 would compute the 47 base equivalents twice (about 2.1 L40S h) and push T-1 past its 3.5 h cap. Projected T-1 total with D5: 4 x 0.555 + smoke + 12 equivalents x 0.0455 h = about 2.8 h.
